statement: Linux v7.3 hid-playstation exposes four Edge-only EV_KEY controls: Fn1 from buttons[2] bit 4 as BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY1, Fn2 from bit 5 as BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY2, left paddle from bit 6 as BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY3, and right paddle from bit 7 as BTN_TRIGGER_HAPPY4. The driver advertises all four capabilities for is_edge.

applicability.scope: Linux v7.3 source-defined gamepad evdev codes; live events not observed
